_NOTE_ConnectionStrings: Set ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection via env var. The previous host/credentials committed in this file have been removed and MUST be rotated.
_NOTE_Jwt: Set Jwt__Key via env var (64+ random chars). The previous committed key has been removed and MUST be rotated.
_NOTE_Cors: Set Cors__AllowedOrigins to a comma-separated allow-list of trusted origins in non-Development environments.
